importMowerScheduleDetails: Imports primary assignments for control, trading, manufacturing, power, dormitories, reception, office and workshop, including operators outside your Box. Free becomes an empty slot. Training, activity rooms, replacement groups, rest rules and backup plans are not preserved.
mowerExportQuestion: Export the current shift to Mower?
mowerExportDetails: Exports only shift {shift} as a basic assignment plan. Production rooms are mapped to B101 through B303 in trading, manufacturing, then power order. Check physical room positions and configure replacements and rest rules in Mower. Timing, drones, Fiammetta and training settings are not exported.
mowerExportFailed: Export failed. Check the selected shift, the limit of 9 production rooms and 4 dormitories, and specify a product for every factory.

changesRemainAvailableForThisVisitButCou: Changes remain available for this visit but could not be saved locally.

thisTargetIsStoredOnlyForTheActiveShift: Only operators assigned to a facility in the active shift can be selected. Assign operators on this page first. This target applies only to the active shift.
onlyOwnedOperatorsInTheCurrentBoxAreShow: Only owned operators in the current Box are shown.
scheduleFileTooLarge: The schedule file must be 5 MiB or smaller.
invalidMaaSchedule: Could not import this MAA schedule file. Check that it contains a valid plans array.
importMaaScheduleDescription: Confirming uses the imported file as the source of truth and replaces the current manual draft and any layout data explicitly provided by the file.

importMaaScheduleDetails: Timed plans become a 24-hour cycle using MAA's Windows client rules: the first matching plan wins overlaps, and the first plan fills gaps. Files without time periods keep sequential mode. Operators outside the current Box are preserved. Facility arrays provided by the file replace matching layout counts, and recognized room products are synchronized to Box & layout; omitted facility types and product settings remain unchanged.
clearEveryFacilityInShift: Clear every facility in this shift
clearEveryFacilityQuestion: Clear every facility in this shift?
clearShiftDescription: Every operator assignment, dormitory autofill setting and drone target in shift {shift} will be cleared. Other shifts will not change.

dormBatchDescription: Select up to {capacity} operators. Selected operators appear first in numbered order. Click a portrait to select or deselect, then apply to fill the current shift's dormitories in that order.
